## Optional binary prediction format check

Fill evaluation IDs, expected method/run pairs and predictions first. This checks format and coverage, never outcome labels or performance. Exclude unexecuted methods from the expected-method manifest and explain their status in the protocol.

```{r format-check}
p <- file.path(ROOT, "results", "test_predictions.csv")
if (file.exists(p)) {
  print(validate_predictions(p, file.path(ROOT, "templates", "evaluation_ids.csv"),
                            file.path(ROOT, "templates", "expected_methods.csv")))
} else {
  cat("Not run: supply completed predictions and manifests first.\n")
}
```
